description: This file defines the 'Location' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_location' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, country, address details, contact info, and relationships to other entities like Country and Employee. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Entity class representing a location in the HRM system, with properties for address, contact info, related country, and associated employees. It utilizes Doctrine annotations for ORM mapping and includes getter and setter methods for all properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the location.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the location.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country associated with the location.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a country with the location.

methods.name: getProvince
methods.description: Gets the province/state of the location.

methods.name: setProvince
methods.description: Sets the province/state for the location.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city of the location.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city of the location.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the location.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the address of the location.

methods.name: getZipCode
methods.description: Returns the ZIP/postal code of the location.

methods.name: setZipCode
methods.description: Sets the ZIP/postal code for the location.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Retrieves the phone number for the location.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the phone number for the location.

methods.name: getFax
methods.description: Returns the fax number for the location.

methods.name: setFax
methods.description: Sets the fax number for the location.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with the location.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes for the location.
